name: io.github.sp3ak/safenode-mcp-gateway
description: Policy enforcement proxy for MCP tool calls. Evaluates every call against SafeNode before forwarding; a denial never reaches the downstream server.

environmentVariables.name: SAFENODE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: SafeNode API key. Free tier at https://safenode.tech — no card required.

environmentVariables.name: SAFENODE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the SafeNode API base URL. Defaults to https://safenode.tech.
